performance_summary.primary_bottleneck: Unpooled Tokyo PostgreSQL connection latency multiplied by model accessor N+1 queries

slow_api_endpoints.root_cause: SectionDashboardController executes overdue() correlated subquery and serializes Document models triggering $appends N+1 lookups
DocumentService::applyVisibility() triggers full sequential scan across documents and tracking_histories tables
Multiple eager relations (originSection, currentEmployee, latestTrackingHistory) loaded sequentially over remote connection
Synchronous DOMPDF generation inside the web request lifecycle blocking the worker

slow_database_queries.query_pattern: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE created_by = ? OR section_id = ? OR id IN (SELECT document_id FROM tracking_histories WHERE from_section_id = ? OR to_section_id = ?)
slow_database_queries.cause: Chained OR and orWhereHas prevent B-Tree index scan in PostgreSQL planner

slow_database_queries.query_pattern: SELECT document_id, MAX(tracked_at) FROM tracking_histories GROUP BY document_id
slow_database_queries.cause: Document::overdue() executes unindexed group-by aggregation on every dashboard request

slow_database_queries.query_pattern: SELECT * FROM tracking_histories WHERE document_id = ? ORDER BY tracked_at DESC LIMIT 1
slow_database_queries.cause: getWaitingSinceAttribute() accessor invoked dynamically during JSON serialization

frontend_rendering_issues.impact: Re-filters and recalculates document stats array on every tab switch or modal event
Renders >150 rows with action buttons and badge components into flat DOM, triggering DOM node bloat (>2,500 elements)
Modal state changes trigger unnecessary re-rendering of entire parent document list
frontend_rendering_issues.recommendation: Isolate modal state and memoize row components

system_resource_bottlenecks.network_latency: Remote Supabase instance located in Tokyo (ap-northeast-1) adds ~550-650ms round-trip latency per unpooled SQL connection
system_resource_bottlenecks.cpu_bottlenecks: PostgreSQL sequential scans on documents table under multi-user access cause database CPU utilization spikes
system_resource_bottlenecks.memory_concerns: In-memory DOMPDF generation and GD avatar resizing without dimension limits can spike PHP process RAM to 128MB+ limit
system_resource_bottlenecks.io_bottlenecks: Local file session reads/writes (SESSION_DRIVER=file) introduce disk I/O contention under concurrent requests
